newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's first-half electricity output rises 3.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Peru's first-half electricity output rises 3.7 pct.

text.p: Peru's electrical power output in the first half of the year rose 3.7 percent to 8,404 gigawatt hours (GWh) compared with the same period last year, the Energy and Mines Ministry said Friday.
The country's output in June rose 3.3 percent year over year to 1,406 gigawatt hours (GWh), the ministry said in a report.
Public service companies accounted for 6,797 GWh in the first half, while companies generating their own power produced the remaining 1,607 GWh of the total.
